# SVGcinema

> SVGcinema is a browser editor for animated SVG (https://asafco83.github.io/svgcinema/). AI assistants that can run scripts in the user's browser tab (Claude in Chrome and others) can edit the open project with its own editing tools, with no API key.

## How to work in SVGcinema

1. Work in the tab where the user has SVGcinema open.
2. Run `window.svgcinema.help()` with your page-script tool and read all of it. It returns a plain-text guide: how to work, the rules, and every tool with its arguments, following the user's current settings (for example how to handle images).
3. Then: `svgcinema.start({ task, assistant })`, `await svgcinema.call(tool, args)` (or `await svgcinema.batch([{ name, args }, ...])`), and `svgcinema.done(summary)`. Everything between start and done is one undo step for the user, and editing is paused for them meanwhile, so always call done().

What the tools cover: shapes and SVG artwork, layers and groups, animation presets, keyframes on any property (position, rotation, scale, opacity, colours, strokes, filters…), shape morphing (Morph keyframes as SVG path data), images, and the project settings.

If `window.svgcinema` is missing, the page isn't SVGcinema or is still loading. If a call answers that the user turned assistants off or pressed Stop, stop and tell them.
